H_slow: dynamic state -> state (confirmed; lagged IBD reservoir, governed by its own RHS)
V_freq: dynamic state -> state (confirmed; among-replicate variance, governed by its own RHS)
V_max: P->P (confirmed, fixed=0.3, within suggested [0.26,0.5]; kept above the V_freq trajectory to avoid the removable singularity)
rationale: Typed ode_system inherited verbatim from the validated contract; only sampling window, fixed parameter values, and noise were chosen. two_Ne=100 sets a ~100-generation drift timescale, so 0-300 generations (300 points) captures the full heterozygosity decline. Parameters were chosen so all six additive terms on dH/dt are comparable in magnitude near the trajectory while keeping the V_freq state well below V_max=0.3 (its equilibrium ~ eta_input/lambda_relax * H ~ 0.5*H ~ 0.17), avoiding the removable singularity at V_freq=V_max. delta_fix=1.0 and V_max=0.3 were taken from the suggested ranges; the resulting new fixation term is visible at 106x sigma near t=300.

scenario_text: A small isolated population experiences random sampling of gametes each generation, causing allele frequencies to drift without any selective pressure. The variance in allele frequency among many independent replicate populations grows as generations pass. Investigators measure how the expected heterozygosity within populations declines over time due to this stochastic sampling. The effective population size remains fixed throughout.
